$comment: Album definitions. This is authored content - the title, category and the Drive folder - so it lives in git and seeds an empty local store. It deliberately contains NO photo metadata: media rows are regenerated from the Drive folder by pressing Sync, which keeps roughly forty Drive file ids out of the repository. Editing an album in the admin rewrites .data/work-albums.json and does NOT change this file, so re-sync that album's folder here if you want a definition change to survive a fresh clone.
